title.zh: 活跃通勤（须登记个人代步工具）命令 2019
title.en: Active Mobility (Registrable Personal Mobility Devices) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Registrable Personal Mobility Devices) Order 2019 and comes into operation on 2 January 2019.

heading.en: What is a registrable personal mobility device

text.en:
2.—(1) A personal mobility device is a registrable personal mobility device if the device —
(a)has an electric motor attached to the device;
[S 353/2026 wef 01/06/2026]
(b)has handlebars; and
[S 353/2026 wef 01/06/2026]
(c)is not a motorised luggage.
[S 353/2026 wef 01/06/2026]
(2) To avoid doubt, a personal mobility device that meets the description in sub‑paragraph (1) is registrable whether or not it has any seat.
(3) In this paragraph, “motorised luggage” means a suitcase that —
(a)has one or more wheels;
(b)is propelled by an electric motor attached to or integrated into the suitcase; and
(c)is built to transport —
(i)a rider; and
(ii)an individual’s luggage within the suitcase.
[S 353/2026 wef 01/06/2026]
